BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has purchased 406,746 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities at a volume-weighted average price of 920.7300 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 930.0000 pence and the lowest at 903.4000 pence. These shares were acquired from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc as part of the share buyback program announced on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026, and all purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 22 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
